$comment: Dispatch-level byte-limit case (RFC 0004). The text is 2,097,153 x U+00E9 = 4,194,306 UTF-8 bytes (> 4 MiB) while staying at 2,097,153 code points, so it passes the schema's code-point maxLength and MUST be rejected by dispatch with bad_request. semantic:true means the artifact check does not assert schema rejection.

invalid.name: set text over 4 MiB of UTF-8 bytes via multi-byte characters
